title: Replication of METR Autonomous Capability Evals on LangGraph vs. AutoGen: Do Results Generalize?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Tests generalizability of safety evaluation results across frameworks. If scores are framework-dependent, current safety evaluations are less reliable than assumed. Clear implication for how we trust evaluation results.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires setting up three different agent frameworks (METR harness, LangGraph, AutoGen), running the same tasks across all three, and comparing results. Multi-framework setup is moderately complex. Requires familiarity with at least three different systems.

narrow_scope.reasoning: 10 tasks x 2 models x 3 frameworks = 60 experimental runs. Plus framework setup for all three. This is a substantial engineering and compute effort well beyond 30hrs for beginners.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
